profile.headline: Software Engineer Lead at Clearwave Corporation

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer Manager
positions.description:
●	Mitigated risks by assessing issues and devising strategies to remove said risks
●	Managed four software engineers, managed schedules, conducted performance reviews, etc
●	Tracked and created reports on team metrics each sprint
●	Managed timelines and deliverables by breaking down items into smaller units of work that could be delivered and communicating effectively throughout the lifecycle of the project
●	Ensured team met the Definition of Done on work items
●	Collaborated with an offshore team from Israel to develop the company’s first API proxy using Open API
●	Assisted team with development of this API proxy to call the electronic medical records (EMRs) FHIR API to fetch patient data, search for patients, create a patient, etc.
●	Point of contact for a Vietnamese offshore company creating additional API proxies with other EMR APIs and served as the principal engineer for any knowledge transfer
●	Conducted thorough examinations on pull requests
●	Assisted team with creating unit tests using xUnit
●	Led a team of two software engineers and one QA on developing high-quality products
●	Certified Scrum Master as of June 2021
●	Served as Scrum Master since January 2020 for my scrum team and lead/organized all scrum ceremonies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Extensive experience working as well as developer lead on EMRs for key companies such as Athenahealth, Modernizing Medicine, and Nextech
●	Point of Contact for API partners 
●	Added UI elements in HTML and css/bootstrap
●	Created scheduled jobs using Quartz to pull in information (appointments, patient data, etc) from the API
●	Integrated by adding the logic to call the endpoints to update patient data, fetch patient data, etc and display the data in the Clearwave applications
●	Assisted in leading and being the point of contact for a 3rd party team in developing an Angular/NodeJS application that tracks and manages student immunization forms
●	Mitigated risks 
●	Ensured deliverables were met by any 3rd party offshore team or personal items
●	Maintained application after the outsourced contract was ended
●	Conducted thorough examinations on pull requests

positions.title: service concierge
positions.description:
•	Perform vehicle inspection with customers to check for previous damages on courtesy cars as   well as checking in returned courtesy cars
•	File paperwork and answer/direct calls as well as trained with the receptionist and cashier to be able to perform their tasks and duties as well

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
•	Greet customers and asses needs 
•	Promote the store credit card 
•	Ring customers at the register 
•	Maintain the store area 
•	Was Associate of the Quarter for July 28, 2013
